header.description: Dipole P2M and P2L coefficients and the dipole direct sum (docs/CONVENTIONS.md §3.7, 'Dipole sources') at seeded random points
header.layout: real storage, index n*n + n + m for -n <= m <= n (§3.6)
header.format: decimal strings, 17 significant digits of the nearest double; moments in the units of the points (the operators divide them by the frame radius); potential and gradient without 1/(4 pi)
